actions.tryAnotherVersion: Try another version of this section (AI)

pageSettings.title: Page Settings
pageSettings.publishTogetherHint: Pages go live together when you hit Publish in the top bar.

hideSiteChrome.label: Hide site header & footer
hideSiteChrome.hint: Turn on when the page already includes its own navigation and footer — otherwise visitors see two of each.

seo.heading: SEO
seo.metaDescriptionPlaceholder: Brief page description for search engines...
seo.previewNoDescription: Add a description — search engines will otherwise pick their own text from the page.

theme.heading: Theme
theme.customColorHint: Overrides the preset color with a custom brand color.
theme.ownPaletteNote: This site's own palette overrides most preset colours in light mode.

fonts.heading: Typography
fonts.pairingHint: Pair a serif heading with a sans body for an editorial, premium feel.

whatsapp.heading: WhatsApp button
whatsapp.hint: Shows a floating WhatsApp button on every page of your website. Taps are counted as enquiries in your analytics.
whatsapp.prefilledMessagePlaceholder: Hi! I'd like to know about your batches.

tracking.heading: Tracking & Analytics
tracking.hint: Paste IDs from Google Analytics / Meta Events Manager. They load only on your public website pages, and every form submission fires a Lead conversion event automatically — so ad campaigns can optimise on real enquiries.
tracking.gtmHint: Use GTM alone, or GA4/Pixel directly — both work.

courseFinder.heading: Course Finder Wizard
courseFinder.hint: Asks visitors to pick filters step by step the first time they open this page, then shows only the matching courses. Options are pulled live from this page's own course grid — nothing extra to configure.
courseFinder.stepsOrderHint: Asked in this fixed order — skipping any step left unchecked, or any step this page's courses have no options for.

coursePages.heading: Course Pages
coursePages.hint: Choose what each course opens when a visitor clicks View course. Courses you leave out keep the standard details page.
coursePages.empty: No courses set yet — every course opens the standard details page.
coursePages.unsetRowHint: Pick a page, or this course falls back to the standard details page.
coursePages.noPages: This catalogue has no other published page yet. Add one under Pages, then come back.
coursePages.noCourses: No courses found for this institute.

modeHint.DETAILS: The usual course page: highlights, syllabus as picture cards, price and enrol.
modeHint.PAGE: Opens a page from this site instead. Build it under Pages first.
modeHint.OUTLINE: Syllabus first, drawn as a plain folder list instead of the default picture cards.
modeHint.TILES: Same as outline, but the subjects show as picture cards using each subject's image, like the admin dashboard.

seo.heading: Search engine optimisation (SEO)
seo.hint: How search engines and social networks read this site. Each page also has its own title, description and share image under Page settings.
seo.keywordsPlaceholder: AI courses, learn AI, AI for teachers
seo.keywordsHint: Comma-separated. The terms people would search to find you — lead with your brand name.
seo.verificationHint: Paste the "content" value from Search Console's HTML-tag method. Then submit your sitemap there.
seo.organizationHint: Shown to search engines as structured data — this is what links your name, logo and profiles into one brand result.
seo.orgLogoHint: A clean logo on a plain background, at least 112×112 px. Leave empty to use the institute logo.
seo.sameAsHint: One URL per line. Links already in your footer are included automatically.
seo.sitemapHint: A sitemap is generated automatically at /<catalogue>/sitemap.xml (and /sitemap.xml when the site is served from your own domain).

palette.heading: Site colours
palette.hint: This site's own colours. Change one here and every part of the site that uses it follows.
palette.applyToTokensHint: Also recolours the standard text, background and line colours of the site (light mode).
palette.contentWidthHint: Width of the page content in pixels, from {{min}} to {{max}}. Leave empty for the default.
palette.contentWidthNotSaved: Not saved: enter a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}.

coursePage.heading: Course page
coursePage.hint: Choose which parts show on each course's public page. Everything is on by default.
coursePage.contentHint: The Course content tab (Table of Contents on e-books) with the course's modules and slides.
coursePage.contentHeadingHint: The "Course Content (Modules & Slides)" line above the course structure. The structure itself stays.
coursePage.seriesHint: The "Part of …" chips listing the other steps of the learning path the course is in, and the "Next in the series" card.
coursePage.seriesLimitHint: Shows this many steps around the current course, numbered from 1. Leave empty to show every step.

fromTags.enable: Add new course tags as formats
fromTags.hint: On: every course tag that is not a language, a stream or category, or one of the skips below becomes a format by itself — it shows in the Format filter and on cards with no edit here. Formats above keep their names.

courseFormats.heading: Course formats
courseFormats.hint: Formats such as E-books or Live sessions show on course cards and in the Format filter. A course gets a format from its tag format-<id>.
courseFormats.namesInTranslations: Format names are translated in Languages → Translations. Switch the editor to the base language to rename or add a format.
courseFormats.renameHint: Renaming a format copies its translations to the new name. Check them in Languages → Translations.
courseFormats.name: Name
courseFormats.confirmRemove: Remove “{{name}}”? Courses tagged {{tag}} will no longer show this format, and its matching settings are lost.
courseFormats.noNameWarning: A format with no name is hidden on the site.
courseFormats.tagHint: Added. Tag courses {{tag}} so they show under “{{name}}”.

issue.noId: Type an ID in English letters or digits.
issue.badId: The ID must start with a letter or digit and use only a-z, 0-9 and dashes.
issue.taken: A format with this ID already exists.
issue.tooMany: The site shows at most {{max}} formats. Remove one to add another.

chromeLook.siteColourNote: Not set: the site's own colour is used.

columnLayout.slotEmpty: Empty — drag a component here from the library

mediaShowcase.heading: Showcase Settings
mediaShowcase.noMediaItems: No media items yet. Click "Add Item" to get started.

bookCatalogue.heading: Catalogue Settings
bookCatalogue.title: Title
bookCatalogue.imageFitHint: Use "Fit whole image" when covers are wide banners with text near the edges.
bookCatalogue.defaultSortHint: How courses are ordered when the page opens. Learners can still change it. Pick "Price: Low to High" to show free courses first.
bookCatalogue.titleWithHero: Extra heading above the tabs (usually empty)
bookCatalogue.titleWithHeroHint: The page heading visitors see comes from this section's page header (hero). Text here adds a second heading.
bookCatalogue.legacyFiltersSummary: More filters from course data (not used by this design)
bookCatalogue.legacyFiltersHint: This page's sidebar has its own filter groups. Ticking one of these adds an extra group after them.
bookCatalogue.optionOrderHint: Not set yet: the site uses its default order. Move any item to set this order.

catalogDesign.title: Courses page design
catalogDesign.hint: Texts and lists of this page's own design. Ids and colours stay in "Edit as JSON".

common.heading: Heading
common.noStreams: The stream tabs are not loaded yet, or this page has none.

hero.groupHint: The band at the top of the page: heading, intro, numbers, search and Popular chips.
hero.title: Page heading
hero.titleHint: The main heading of the page. Leave it empty for no heading.
hero.breadcrumbHint: The trail above the heading. The last item is this page and is never a link.
hero.statsHint: Live counts next to the heading (up to 3).
hero.popularHint: Shortcuts under the search box (up to 8).
hero.resultsHint: The "Showing N courses" line above the results.
hero.countHint: {count} is replaced by the number of courses.
hero.allStreamsLabel: Chip text when no stream is picked
hero.groupResultsHint: The "Showing N courses" line and the text before the quick filters.

rows.group: Rows above and below the courses
rows.groupHint: The free-courses strip, the flagship panel and the coming-soon row.
rows.subtitle: Line under the heading
rows.freeCoursesHint: Free courses only, in this order; other free courses fill the rest. The first {{limit}} show.
rows.seeAllHint: {count} is replaced by the number of free courses.
rows.slidesHint: The course, invite and session the button opens are set in "Edit as JSON".
rows.priceToken: {price} is replaced by the live price.
rows.priceHint: Used only when the live price cannot be read, e.g. ₹1,001.
rows.categoriesHint: Only coming-soon categories with a notify form can show. None ticked = all of them.
rows.buttonTextHint: {price} is replaced by the live price. Empty removes the button.
rows.noButton: This slide has no button. A button is set up in "Edit as JSON".
rows.removeSlideConfirm: This slide's button opens a course or form set in "Edit as JSON". Removing the slide removes those ids too. Remove it?
rows.noComingSoon: No category is marked coming soon with a notify form yet. Mark one in the folder library.

sidebar.groupHint: The filter groups, their order and the app card under them.
sidebar.title: Sidebar heading
sidebar.orderHint: Turn a group off to hide it. The arrows change the order.
sidebar.formatsNote: The options are the course formats in Site settings.
sidebar.tagPrefixHint: Every course tag starting with this word becomes an option, after the options below: "for parents" shows as Parents. A new tag on a course shows here with no edit.
sidebar.tagPrefixMissing: Type the word the tags start with (for example: for).
sidebar.tagExcludeHint: Comma-separated, the whole tag or the part after the word (for example: everyone).
sidebar.tagsHint: Separated by commas. A course with any of these tags matches.
sidebar.promoHint: The dark card under the filters.
sidebar.imageHint: A ready-made picture replaces the drawn phone.
sidebar.storeLinksHint: Add a store link to show Google Play / App Store badges in place of the button.
sidebar.urlKeyReserved: The page already uses this key for something else, so the site hides this group. Change the id in "Edit as JSON".
sidebar.needsTag: Add at least one tag: an option without tags is not shown.

cards.groupHint: Texts on the course cards. Empty fields use the built-in text.
cards.formatLabelsHint: Short names for the format pill. Empty uses the name from Site settings.
cards.descriptionsHint: Replace a course's own description on its card.
cards.addDescription: Add a description for a course…
cards.countLabelHint: {{shown}} and {{total}} are replaced by the numbers.

generic.complexPropertiesHidden: Some complex properties are hidden. Expand component details to view full JSON.

header.heading: Header Settings
header.title: Title
header.syncPagesTitle: Add and order your published pages. Mega menus, outside links and hidden links stay as they are.
header.authCtaHint: Buttons shown on the right side of the header (e.g. Login, Sign Up). A "Get Started" button opens the legacy lead-collection form; "Open form popup" opens any Audience campaign's form (Enquire Now, event registration) — pick the campaign below the toggle.

headerLook.heading: Look
headerLook.navStyleHint: Editorial: plain text links, the current page in bold.
headerLook.logoOnlyHint: Hide the site name next to the logo.

headerExtras.heading: Header extras
headerExtras.searchHint: A search icon that finds courses, pages and mega-menu streams.
headerExtras.languageSwitchHint: हिन्दी | EN — the other languages first, the site's main language last. Appears once the site has more than one language (Global Settings); on phones it sits in the menu.
headerExtras.logoClickHint: Where visitors go when they click the logo or site name. Home page is the default.

footer.heading: Footer Settings
footer.noSocialLinks: No social links yet — click Add.
footer.brandDesignNote: This footer uses its own design: it always shows four link columns, and the layout and presets do not apply.
footer.useStandardConfirm: Switch to a standard footer? Your links and text are kept; the layout and presets apply again. Undo brings the brand design back.

footerBrand.languageSwitchHint: Shows once the site has more than one language.

hero.heading: Hero Section Settings
hero.backgroundImageHint: A background image covers the background color. Clear it to use the color below.
hero.ctaButtonsHint: When any button has text here, it replaces the single legacy button below. Learner shows up to 3.
hero.videoHint: Paste a YouTube or Vimeo link, or upload a video file. A video takes priority over the image and carousel above.
hero.carouselImagesHint: Add 2 or more images to turn the hero media into an auto-playing carousel. With one image it stays a single image; with none it uses the Right Image above.

heroEditorial.styleHint: Editorial: breadcrumb, a two-colour title, check bullets and an unframed picture.
heroEditorial.heading: Editorial details
heroEditorial.breadcrumbHint: Items with a link are clickable; the last one is this page.
heroEditorial.mediaWidthClamped: Picture width must be 200 to 800; it was set to {{value}}.

testimonials.heading: Testimonials Settings
testimonials.cardsPerViewHint: Tablets show up to 2 and phones show 1.

ctaBand.styleHint: Band: a full-width strip with an eyebrow, two buttons and an optional phone picture.
ctaBand.phoneHint: A phone with your picture on its screen, beside the text.
ctaBand.storeLinksHint: Add a store link to show Google Play / App Store badges in place of the button.

contactForm.heading: Contact Form Settings
contactForm.submissionsHint: Submissions land as leads in the campaign above (or the default website-leads list) — visible in Audience Manager → Recent Leads, with dedup and counsellor assignment.

campaignPicker.newCampaignHint: Starts with Full Name, Email and Phone Number. Add more fields any time in Audience Manager.
campaignPicker.createError: Could not create it — please try again.
campaignPicker.campaignsFromHint: Campaigns come from Audience Manager — edit their form fields there.

leadForm.hint: Renders a campaign's registration form right on the page. Fields, options and mandatory flags are configured on the campaign in Audience Manager; submissions land in that campaign with dedup, scoring and counsellor assignment.
leadForm.subtitle: Subtitle
leadForm.successMessagePlaceholder: Thank you! We've received your details.

productPageOffer.hint: Shows a product page's courses here and sends each click straight into that page's cart. The course list, prices and images are read live from the product page — edit them there, not here.
productPageOffer.pageNotActiveWarning: This page is {{status}} — set it {{activeStatus}} or the section stays hidden to visitors.
productPageOffer.noProductPages: No product pages yet — create one under Manage Pages > Product Pages.
productPageOffer.subtitlePlaceholder: Pick a program and enrol in minutes.
productPageOffer.checkoutModeCartHint: Each card adds to a basket and a bar at the foot of the page takes the whole selection to checkout together. Use this when a visitor normally buys more than one — a class's set of subjects, say.
productPageOffer.checkoutModeSingleHint: Each card goes straight into checkout with that one course. Turn this on to let a visitor collect several first.
productPageOffer.checkoutCtaHint: Shown on the basket bar, not on the cards.
productPageOffer.viewCourseHint: Opens the course details page; enrolling from there returns to this product page's checkout.
productPageOffer.seeAllToggle: "See all" link to the product page
productPageOffer.carouselDescription: Cards sit in one row that visitors swipe or scroll sideways; arrows appear when there is more to see. Columns sets how many are visible at once.
productPageOffer.pageSizeAllHint: Every course renders in one long grid — only sensible for short lists.
productPageOffer.pageSizePagedHint: Visitors page through the list; the canvas shows the first page.
productPageOffer.railAllHint: Every course sits in one row — a long product page makes that row very long.
productPageOffer.railCappedHint: The row stops here and ends with a card linking to the full product page.
productPageOffer.searchBoxHint: Shown only when the product page has 8+ courses.

productCourseGrid.wholeCatalogueHint: This block shows your entire course catalogue — it is not tied to a product page, so there is no product page to pick here. To show one product page's courses (and send clicks into its cart), switch to Product Page Offer.

htmlPage.someWontRender: Some of this paste will not render
htmlPage.styleBlocksLost_one: {{count}} <style> block — style tags are stripped, so this CSS is lost
htmlPage.styleBlocksLost_other: {{count}} <style> blocks — style tags are stripped, so this CSS is lost
htmlPage.linkedStylesheets_one: {{count}} linked stylesheet — paste that CSS into the CSS field
htmlPage.linkedStylesheets_other: {{count}} linked stylesheets — paste that CSS into the CSS field
htmlPage.scriptsRemoved_one: {{count}} script — removed; use the action attributes below instead
htmlPage.scriptsRemoved_other: {{count}} scripts — removed; use the action attributes below instead
htmlPage.moveStylesToCss: Move styles into the CSS field
htmlPage.pasteHint: Paste the page you built elsewhere. Scripts, forms and iframes are removed; SVG, images and your CSS are kept. Put <styletag/> contents in the CSS field — style tags are stripped.
htmlPage.cssSharedHint: Shared across several pasted pages? Put it in Global Settings → Custom CSS instead, so it is stored once rather than per page.
htmlPage.linksHint: A plain link leaves the site, and #anchor cannot work inside the page's shadow root. Use these instead — pasted links are converted automatically where we can:
htmlPage.aiHelpTitle: No page yet? Build one with ChatGPT or Claude
htmlPage.aiStep1: Copy the prompt below and paste it into ChatGPT or Claude
htmlPage.aiStep2: Replace the last paragraph with a description of your page
htmlPage.aiStep3: Paste its HTML into the HTML field and its CSS into the CSS field
htmlPage.aiStep4: Upload your images, then point the buttons where you want them
htmlPage.aiCopiedBody: Paste it into ChatGPT or Claude, then describe the page you want.
htmlPage.aiPromptHint: The prompt already explains our rules to the AI, so what it writes will work here without you needing to know them.

htmlBlock.hint: Custom section — rendered sandboxed (no scripts). Style it with the CSS field below using theme variables like <code1/>, <code2/> and <code3/> so it follows your site theme.
htmlBlock.aiSectionBriefTip: Tip: ask the AI copilot to "redesign this section" — it uses this brief.

tabsAccordion.splitHint: Split shows the open item's panel on the right (desktop). Panels can hold nested components via JSON/templates; rich text renders otherwise.

sectionHeading.highlightNotFound: Not found in the title — the highlight will not show.
sectionHeading.leadPlaceholder: One-sentence supporting copy under the title

logoCloud.tickerHint: One announcement per line — these scroll across the band.
logoCloud.tickerPlaceholder:
e.g.
GATE 2026 batches open
ISRO/BARC post-GATE batches
30,000+ students trained
logoCloud.labelPlaceholder: Label (company name, shown in labeled modes)

detailBlocks.hint: One block per programme — a detail table plus a label/value spec strip. Built for reference pages, so it carries no price or enrol button by design.
detailBlocks.headerStyleHint: Give just one block "solid" so the flagship stands out.
detailBlocks.detailItemsLabel: Detail items — one per line, "Title — Description"

featureGrid.categoryParamHint: Each tile sets ?{key}=<its value> (a tile with no value shows everything). Give the sections below a visibility rule on the same key to show them only for that category.
featureGrid.photoStyleHint: Photo = the image fills the card with the text over it. Cards with no image fall back to a tinted card, so a rail can mix photos and colour blocks. Give each card a Link to get a button.
featureGrid.swipeableRow: Swipeable row instead of a grid
featureGrid.panelStyleHint: Panel = tinted-header division cards. Per card, set a Badge and a Header color/style below.
featureGrid.resourceStyleHint: Resource = library cards: 16:9 thumbnail, badge (e.g. Featured), chips for age group / duration, and a full-width button. Use Download / Read / Watch / Listen as the link text.
featureGrid.gateTitlePlaceholder: Popup title (e.g. Get your free printables)
featureGrid.gateHint: Visitors fill the list's form once (e.g. name, email, phone); after that every gated card and article on the site opens directly in that browser. Edit the form's fields in Audience Manager; responses export from there.
featureGrid.uploadPdf: Or upload a PDF (fills the link URL)
featureGrid.gateNeedsList: Pick a list under "Email before download" above, otherwise this card opens without asking.
featureGrid.gateAll: Ask for details before opening every card in this section
featureGrid.useFreebiesList: Use the Freebies list (created for you)
featureGrid.freebiesListError: Could not set up the Freebies list. Pick a list above instead.

imageBlock.linkPlaceholder: Link this image to a page or URL

buttonBlock.whatsappNumberHint: Leave blank to use the site-wide number from Global Settings.
buttonBlock.whatsappMessagePlaceholder: Hi! I'd like to know about…

documentViewer.heading: Document Viewer Settings
documentViewer.fileNameHelp: Used when a visitor downloads the PDF. Leave blank to use the uploaded file's name.
documentViewer.displayButton: Button that opens a full-screen reader
documentViewer.displayButtonHelp: One call-to-action; the PDF opens over the page, like a presentation.
documentViewer.displayInlineHelp: The first page shows directly in the page, with a Full screen button.
documentViewer.onlyPdf: Only PDF files can be uploaded here.
documentViewer.tooLarge: That PDF is over {{max}} MB. Compress it first — large files load slowly on phones.

blog.heading: Blog Settings
blog.managePostsHint: Posts are written and published separately, so a new article never needs the site republished.
blog.pageSizeHelp: Older posts are reached with Newer / Older buttons.
blog.viewMoreRouteHelp: Fill this to make a short teaser (e.g. on the home page): no pager, a button to that page, and articles open there. Use the route of the page that has the full blog, e.g. blog.
blog.categoryHelp: Pin the section to one category, e.g. a News page and a separate Tips page.
blog.emptyMessage: Message when there are no posts
blog.gateTitlePlaceholder: Popup title (e.g. Read our free articles)
blog.gateHint: Pick a list and every article opens only after its form is filled once. The same list on resource cards means one form unlocks both.
blog.articleSectionsHeading: Also show under an open article
blog.articleSectionsHint: Ticked sections of this page stay below the article (after recommended courses), e.g. a newsletter signup. Everything else hides while an article is open.

sectionJson.buttonHint: Edit this section's settings as JSON, including values that have no field yet
sectionJson.title: Edit this section as JSON
sectionJson.hint: Only this section's settings. Apply replaces them in one step; Undo brings the old ones back.
sectionJson.notObject: The settings must be one JSON object: { … }.
sectionJson.errorAt: Not valid JSON at line {{line}}, column {{column}}: {{message}}
sectionJson.baseLanguageOnly: Switch to the base language to edit the JSON

sectionVersion.keptSettings: {{count}} settings this version did not include were kept. Use Undo to go back, or open “Edit as JSON” to see them.
sectionVersion.keepsNote: Also keeps {{count}} settings this version leaves out: {{names}}

marquee.noItems: No items yet — add one to show the ticker.
marquee.defaultIconHint: Shown before items that have no icon of their own. Leave blank for none.

autoScroll.label: Auto-scroll
autoScroll.hint: Moves one card at a time and pauses while the visitor hovers, taps or tabs into the row.
autoScroll.loopOnHint: The row keeps going round: after the last card comes the first again.
autoScroll.loopOffHint: At the last card the row scrolls back to the first.

jobOpenings.hint: A card per job; each job opens as its own page under this page (for example /careers/teacher) with an Apply button to your form. Untitled or switched-off jobs are hidden.
jobOpenings.columnsHint: On phones every template shows one card per row.
jobOpenings.title: Job title
jobOpenings.addressHidden: Hidden: give it a title and switch it on to publish it.
jobOpenings.applyUrlHint: Google Form or any https link. Opens in a new tab.
jobOpenings.applyUrlInvalid: Use a full https:// link, or the Apply button will not show.
jobOpenings.applyLabel: Apply button text for this job (optional)

defaults.empty: No open positions right now — check back soon.

classic.name: Classic
classic.hint: Cards with a small photo and chips

poster.name: Poster
poster.hint: Your poster on top, never cropped

list.name: List
list.hint: One row per job, button on the right

dark.name: Dark
dark.hint: Dark band with a brand glow

spotlight.name: Spotlight
spotlight.hint: First job large, the rest in a grid

split.name: Split detail
split.hint: Cards; job page with a sticky Apply panel
